news_items.headline: Nebius Group acquires Eigen AI for $643 million to enhance inference platform
news_items.summary: Nebius announced a $643M acquisition of Eigen AI, a model inference and optimization specialist. Eigen's technology reduces compute and memory usage for running AI models and will be integrated into Nebius's Token Factory managed inference platform.

news_items.headline: NBIS stock surges 11–14% following Eigen AI acquisition announcement
news_items.summary: Nebius shares climbed over 11% intraday on May 4 following the Eigen AI deal announcement, with some sources citing a session gain of up to 14.03% as investor enthusiasm around AI infrastructure spending drove the move.

news_items.headline: Nebius lands TD SYNNEX AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service partnership
news_items.summary: Nebius announced it is powering TD SYNNEX's new AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service offering using its AI-native cloud platform and NVIDIA HGX B300 clusters, giving Nebius distribution reach through TD SYNNEX's global partner and enterprise client base.

news_items.headline: Nebius stock slumps as post-acquisition rally fades - TipRanks
news_items.summary: NBIS gave back a portion of its May 4 gains on May 5 as the initial acquisition-driven rally cooled. No new fundamental negative catalysts were cited; the pullback was described as a momentum pause.

news_items.headline: Goldman Sachs raises NBIS price target following Meta AI contract
news_items.summary: Goldman Sachs raised its price target for Nebius after the company secured a substantial contract with Meta AI, reaffirming a positive investment rating ahead of the May 13 Q1 earnings report.

news_items.headline: Nebius Q1 2026 earnings preview: analysts expect ~$388.6M revenue, ~600% YoY growth
news_items.summary: Street consensus calls for Q1 2026 revenue of approximately $388.6M, representing roughly 600% year-over-year growth. Key watch items are ARR trajectory, EBITDA resilience, and hyperscaler deployment updates.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Goldman Sachs raised its price target following a Meta AI contract (reported ~2026-05-04); consensus among 10–11 analysts is Strong Buy / Buy with average PT of ~$174 (range $126–$215). No downgrades found in the last 7 days.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 earnings report scheduled for May 13. Street expects ~$388.6M revenue (~600% YoY growth); key metrics are ARR trajectory, EBITDA margin, and commentary on the Eigen AI integration and hyperscaler deployments.
